question: Who is awarded the "Player of the Series" for the Cricket Test Series between India and Australia concluded in Jan 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pat Cummins**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In November 2021, Pat Cummins was named the captain of Australia's Test cricket team.
 
• He was the **first fast bowler to lead Australia** in Test cricket after Ray Lindwall (who captained one match in 1956).
 
• The series consisted of four Test matches played between December 2020 and January 2021.
 
• **India won the series 2-1,** retaining the Border-Gavaskar Trophy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **first international cricket match** was played between the United States and Canada in 1844.
 
• However, it was not until 1877 that the **first Test match** was played between Australia and England.
 
• In 2021, **India played the highest number of international matches**, with a total of 42 matches across all formats.
 
• **Sachin Tendulkar** holds the record for the most runs in international cricket, scoring 34,357 runs across all formats.
 
• The record for the** fastest century** in ODIs is held by AB de Villiers, who reached 100 runs off just 31 balls against the West Indies in 2015.
 
• The record for the **most wickets in One Day Internationals** (ODIs) is held by Muttiah Muralitharan, with 534 wickets during his career.
 
• The **highest individual score** in Test cricket is 400 not out, achieved by Brian Lara of the West Indies against England in 2004.
 
• **Women’s cricket** has gained immense popularity, with the inaugural Women’s T20 World Cup taking place in 2009.
